name: posh
description: Makes Codex check POSH documentation for the project's exact Ruby and gem versions. Requires POSH to be installed and activated.

interface.shortDescription: Docs for your exact Ruby and gem versions
interface.longDescription: Search and read local Ruby, Rails, and gem documentation matched to the project's Ruby version and Gemfile.lock, and check it before relying on memory.
defaultPrompt: Check the POSH docs before changing this Rails code.
Find what changed in this gem's changelog for our version.
